name: BoneMarrowMap: A Balanced Single-cell Reference Atlas of Human Hematopoiesis
description: We provide a large-scale reference atlas of human hematopoiesis with balanced representation of CD34+ stem and progenitor cells together with terminally differentiated populations. Our reference map of 263,159 hematopoietic cells provides us with deep portraits of lineage transitions in both early and late stages of human hematopoiesis, spanning 55 cellular states.

labelsets.name: AuthorCellType
labelsets.description:
To derive cell state annotations, we performed graph-based leiden clustering across different resolutions (from 0.5 to 20). We found that unbiased metrics to select the optimal number of clusters such as the silhouette score were highly correlated with the number of clusters and inappropriate for use. Instead, we employed a flexible cluster assignment approach, wherein leiden clusters assigned at different resolutions were evaluated for their concordance with biological priors and assigned as specific cell states accordingly, with boundaries between cell states being informed by this prior information. These priors were dependent on the specific lineage being annotated:

●	For differentiated cell populations including T cells, NK cells, B cells, Plasma cells, stromal cells, megakaryocytes, eosinophil/basophil/mast cells, pDCs, and cDCs, we leveraged existing annotations from bulk Bone Marrow references including Hay et al (Exp Heme 2018), Seurat Azimuth (Cell 2021), Granja et al (Nat Biotech 2019), and van Galen et al (Cell 2019).

●	For Hematopoietic stem and progenitor cell populations (HSPCs), we performed SingleR scoring from a bulk RNA-seq reference dataset from stringently purified HSPC populations (Xie et al, Blood Cancer Discov 2021) alongside AUCell scoring of gene expression signatures of quiescent and activated HSCs (Garcia-Prat et al, Cell Stem Cell 2021). HSPC population annotations were also refined based on external scRNA-seq validation datasets of sorted HSPCs and an in-house dataset of sorted immunophenotypic LT-HSCs.

●	For populations along B cell development, we performed SingleR scoring from an in-house bulk RNA-seq reference dataset (Iacobucci et al, Nat Cancer 2025) from purified B cell precursors (CLP: CD34+CD38+CD10+CD19-; Pre-Pro-B: CD34+CD38+CD10-CD19+; Pro-B: CD34+CD38+CD10+CD19+; Pre-B: CD34-CD38+CD10+CD19+; Mature B) and utilized previously reported marker genes across stages of B cell development.

●	For populations along erythroid development, we performed SingleR scoring from a bulk RNA-seq reference dataset (An et al, Blood 2014) with purified erythroid populations (Pro-Erythroblast, Basophilic Erythroblast, Polychromatic Erythroblast, Orthochromatic Erythroblast), and utilized previously reported marker genes across stages of erythroid development.

●	Established bulk RNA-seq profiles from sorted human populations between GMP and Monocytes or cDCs are not available, with the primary basis of these populations (e.g. early and late pro-monocytes) being morphological. Given the absence of clear ground truth reference profiles, we placed an emphasis on existing transcriptional annotations of myeloid development, evaluating the labels from Granja et al (Nat Biotech 2019) and projecting labeled BM data from van Galen et al (Cell 2019).

●	As an additional layer of validation, whole transcriptome + Abseq single cell profiles from Triana et al (Nat Immunol 2021) were projected onto the reference map to evaluate the concordance between assigned cell types and surface marker profiles.

labels.name: Small Pre-B
labels.rationale: This population was annotated based on enrichment of a gene expression signature derived from CD34-CD38+CD10+CD19+CD20- Pre-B cells and validated through projection of CITE-seq data to confirm this immunophenotype. Small Pre-B was discerned from Large Pre-B based on the absence of cell cycle activity and the expression of genes involved in Immunoglobulin light chain re-arrangement.

labels.name: Immature B
labels.rationale: This population was annotated based on enrichment of a gene expression signature derived from CD34-CD19+CD20+IgM- Immature B cells and validated through projection of CITE-seq data to confirm this immunophenotype. Immature B cells were discerned from Pre-B cells based on CD20 and from Mature B cells based on CD21 and IgM or IgD surface immunophenotype in CITE-seq data.

labels.name: Pro-B VDJ
labels.rationale: This population was annotated based on enrichment of a gene expression signature derived from CD34+CD38+CD10+CD19+ Pro-B cells and validated through projection of CITE-seq data to confirm this immunophenotype. Pro-B VDJ cells were discerned from Cycling Pro-B cells based on high expression of RAG genes and absence of cell cycle genes, and from Pre-Pro-B based on immunophenotypic CD19 and CD24 expression.

labels.name: Large Pre-B
labels.rationale: This population was annotated based on enrichment of a gene expression signature derived from CD34-CD38+CD10+CD19+CD20- Pre-B cells and validated through projection of CITE-seq data to confirm this immunophenotype. Large Pre-B was discerned from Small Pre-B based on the presence of cell cycle activity. It was distringuished from Pro-B cycling based on Pre-B signature enrichment, a CD34- immunophenotype, and high TCL1A.

labels.name: MLP
labels.rationale: This population was annotated based on enrichment of a gene expression signature derived from Lin-CD34+CD38-CD90-CD45RA+CD10+ MLP cells and validated through projection of purified scRNA-seq profiles data to confirm this immunophenotype.

labels.name: MPP-MkEry
labels.rationale: This population was annotated based on enrichment of a gene expression signature derived from Lin-CD34+CD38-CD45RA-CD90-CD49f- MPP cells and validated through projection of purified scRNA-seq profiles data to confirm this immunophenotype. Two MPP subsets were defined positioned at the interface between LT-HSC and downstream LMPPs and MEPs. The MPP-MkEy exhibits intermediate expression of gene expression signatures related to LT-HSC and MEP with low expression of an LMPP gene expression signature.

labels.name: Mature B
labels.rationale: This population was annotated based on enrichment of a gene expression signature derived from CD34-CD19+CD20+IgM+ Mature B cells and validated through projection of CITE-seq data to confirm this immunophenotype. Mature B cells were discerned from Immature B cells based on CD21 and IgM or IgD surface immunophenotype in CITE-seq data.

labels.name: CLP
labels.rationale: This population was annotated based on enrichment of a gene expression signature derived from CD34+CD38+CD45RA+CD10+CD19- CLP cells and validated through projection of CITE-seq data to confirm this immunophenotype.

labels.name: Pre-ProB
labels.rationale: This population was annotated based on enrichment of a gene expression signature derived from CD34+CD38+CD45RA+CD10-CD19+ Pre-Pro-B cells and validated through projection of CITE-seq data to confirm this immunophenotype. It was distinguished from Pro-B based on lower surface CD10 in fetal CITE-seq data and the absence of surface CD24 in fetal and post-natal CITE-seq data.

labels.name: MPP-MyLy
labels.rationale: This population was annotated based on enrichment of a gene expression signature derived from Lin-CD34+CD38-CD45RA-CD90-CD49f- MPP cells and validated through projection of purified scRNA-seq profiles data to confirm this immunophenotype. Two MPP subsets were defined positioned at the interface between LT-HSC and downstream LMPPs and MEPs. The MPP-MyLy exhibits intermediate expression of gene expression signatures related to LT-HSC and LMPP with low expression of an MEP gene expression signature.

labels.name: Basophilic Erythroblast
labels.rationale: This population was annotated based on enrichment of a gene expression signature derived from FACS-sorted basophilic erythroblast cells and based on hemoglobin transcripts constituting approximately 5-30% of the transcriptome. It was distinguished from pro-erythroblasts by evaluating the ratio of enrichment for gene expression signatures derived from sorted basophilic erythroblasts versus sorted pro-erthyroblasts.

labels.name: Pro-B Cycling
labels.rationale: This population was annotated based on enrichment of a gene expression signature derived from CD34+CD38+CD10+CD19+CD20- Pro-B cells and validated through projection of CITE-seq data to confirm this immunophenotype. Cycling Pro-B was discerned from Pro-B VDJ based on the presence of cell cycle activity. It was distringuished from Large Pre-B cycling based on Pro-B signature enrichment and a CD34+ immunophenotype.

labels.name: Pre-pDC
labels.rationale: This population represents plasmacytoid dendritic cell precursors and was annotated based on pDC markers including IRF7 and LILRA4. It is distinguished from mature pDCs based on its positioning along pDC development and the absence of pDC maturation markers such as GZMB.

labels.name: Cycling Progenitor
labels.rationale: This population was annotated based as a hematopoietic progenitor population lacking clear lineage-commitment related markers precluding classification as LMPP, GMP, MEP, or otherwise, and marked specifically by high expression of cell-cycle related genes. This population was enriched for a gene expression signature derived from immunophenotypic Lin-CD34+CD38+CD45RA-CD135+ CMP, however recent studies including Drissen 2019 have demonstrated that CMPs do not exist as a pure population and are instead an admixed fraction containing GMPs and MEPs. Thus, we are using the name "Cycling Progenitor"

labels.name: Megakaryocyte Precursor
labels.rationale: This is an MEP-derived megakaryocyte precursor population expressing markers PLEK and ITGA2B (CD41), among others.

labels.name: CD4 Central Memory
labels.fullName: central memory CD4-positive, alpha-beta T cell
labels.ontologyTerm: central memory CD4-positive, alpha-beta T cell
labels.rationale: This CD4 T cell population represents Central Memory T cells, their identity was confirmed by projection using the Hao 2021 PBMC multi-modal atlas.
labels.categoryFullName: CD4-positive, alpha-beta memory T cell, CD45RO-positive
labels.categoryOntologyTerm: CD4-positive, alpha-beta memory T cell, CD45RO-positive

labels.name: NK Proliferating
labels.rationale: This is an NK cell population marked by high cell cycle activity, their identity was confirmed by projection using the Hao 2021 PBMC multi-modal atlas.

labels.name: T Proliferating
labels.rationale: This is a T cell population marked by high cell cycle activity, their identity was confirmed by projection using the Hao 2021 PBMC multi-modal atlas.

labels.name: Plasma Cell
labels.rationale: This is an antibody-producing plasma cell population expressing canonical plasma cell genes including SDC1 (encoding CD138) and XBP1. Its identity was confirmed by projection of labeled PBMC datasets.

labels.name: Pre-pDC Cycling
labels.rationale: This population represents plasmacytoid dendritic cell precursors and was annotated based on pDC markers including IRF7 and LILRA4. It is distinguished from mature pDCs based on the presence of cell cycle activity and absence of pDC maturation markers such as GZMB.

labels.name: EoBasoMast Precursor
labels.rationale: This population represents a GATA2+ granulocyte progenitor population spanning the Eosinophil, Basophil, and Mast Cell lineages. This progenitor has been shown to branch from a common GATA2+ progenitor shared with Mk and Ery lineages rather than deriving from GMP. Top markers include MS4A3, MS4A2, and CLC.

labels.name: pDC
labels.rationale: This population represents plasmacytoid dendritic cells and was annotated based on pDC markers including IRF7 and LILRA4. It is distinguished from Pre-pDCs based on the absence of cell cycle activity and expression of pDC maturation markers such as GZMB.

labels.name: MLP-II
labels.rationale: This population is positioned at an intermediate position between MLP and Pre-pDC. Accordingly, it has intermediate expression of B-lymphoid lineage marker DNTT and DC lineage marker IRF8. It is neither a clear MLP nor clear Pre-pDC population.

labels.name: GMP-Mono
labels.rationale: This population was annotated based on enrichment of a gene expression signature derived from Lin-CD34+CD38+CD45RA+(CD135+/IL3RA+) GMP cells and validated through projection of purified scRNA-seq profiles data to confirm this immunophenotype. This is a committed GMP population with prominent expression of ELANE, PRTN3, AZU1, MPO and is positioned between Early GMP and the Pro-Mono populations.

labels.name: Early GMP
labels.rationale: This population was annotated based on enrichment of a gene expression signature derived from Lin-CD34+CD38+CD45RA+(CD135+/IL3RA+) GMP cells and validated through projection of purified scRNA-seq profiles data to confirm this immunophenotype. Of note, it is not cycling and lacks further committment markers such as ELANE/PRTN3/AZU1 compared to more committed downstream GMP populations.

labels.name: Pre-cDC
labels.rationale: unknown

labels.name: LMPP
labels.rationale: This population was annotated based on enrichment of a gene expression signature derived from Lin-CD34+CD38-CD90-CD45RA+CD10- LMPP cells and validated through projection of purified scRNA-seq profiles data to confirm this immunophenotype.

labels.name: HSC
labels.rationale: This population was annotated based on enrichment of a gene expression signature derived from Lin-CD34+CD38-CD45RA-CD90+CD49f+ LT-HSC cells and validated through projection of purified scRNA-seq profiles data to confirm this immunophenotype. HSCs were stringently defined to maximize concordance with single-cell transcriptomes from purified immunophenotypic LT-HSC.

labels.name: MEP
labels.rationale: This population was annotated based on enrichment of a gene expression signature derived from Lin-CD34+CD38+CD45RA-CD135- MEP cells and validated through projection of purified scRNA-seq profiles data to confirm this immunophenotype.

labels.name: BFU-E
labels.rationale: This population was annotated based on enrichment of a gene expression signature derived from FACS-sorted BFU-E. This population is positioned downstream of the MEP along the Ery branch, separate from the Mk and EoBasoMast branches. It is distinguished from the later CFU-E in part by the absence of hemoglobin expression.

labels.name: GMP-Cycle
labels.rationale: This population was annotated based on enrichment of a gene expression signature derived from Lin-CD34+CD38+CD45RA+(CD135+/IL3RA+) GMP cells and validated through projection of purified scRNA-seq profiles data to confirm this immunophenotype. Of note, this population is cycling but remains distinguishable from cycling progenitors based on GMP-derived gene expression signature enrichment.

labels.name: GMP-Neut
labels.rationale: This population was annotated based on enrichment of a gene expression signature derived from Lin-CD34+CD38+CD45RA+(CD135+/IL3RA+) GMP cells and validated through projection of purified scRNA-seq profiles data to confirm this immunophenotype. This is a committed GMP population with prominent expression of ELANE, PRTN3, AZU1, MPO and overlaps with Neutrophil progenitors identified from a previous study (Granja 2019).

labels.name: Early ProMono
labels.rationale: Pro-monocytes are positioned downstream of GMP-Mono and upstream of CD14 Monocytes. Their labels were confirmed through projection of pro-monocyte single-cell transcriptomes previously labeled by van Galen and colleagues (2019). The Early Pro-Mono is positioned earlier in pseudotime and has acquired no immunophenotypic CD14.

labels.name: CD4 Naive
labels.fullName: naive thymus-derived CD4-positive, alpha-beta T cell
labels.ontologyTerm: naive thymus-derived CD4-positive, alpha-beta T cell
labels.rationale: This is a CD4 naive population that clusters together with CD8 naive T cells. Its identity was confirmed by projection using the Hao 2021 PBMC multi-modal atlas.

labels.name: CFU-E
labels.rationale: This population was annotated based on enrichment of a gene expression signature derived from FACS-sorted CFU-E. This population is positioned downstream of the BFU-E along the Ery branch. It is distinguished from downstream Pro-Erythroblasts based on CD34+. It is distinguished from the upstream BFU-E based on low-level hemoglobin gene expression (~2-5% of the transcriptome).

labels.name: Pro-Erythroblast
labels.rationale: This population was annotated based on enrichment of a gene expression signature derived from FACS-sorted pro-erythroblast cells and based on hemoglobin transcripts constituting approximately 5-30% of the transcriptome. It was distinguished from basophilic erythroblasts by evaluating the ratio of enrichment for gene expression signatures derived from sorted pro-erythroblasts versus sorted basophilic erthyroblasts.

labels.name: NK
labels.rationale: This population clusters with CD8 T cells but lacks immunophenotypic CD3. The identity of these NK cells was confirmed by projection using the Hao 2021 PBMC multi-modal atlas.

labels.name: NK CD56high
labels.fullName: CD16-negative, CD56-bright natural killer cell, human
labels.ontologyTerm: CD16-negative, CD56-bright natural killer cell, human
labels.rationale: This population clusters with CD8 T cells but lacks immunophenotypic CD3. This NK population is further defined based on high expression of CD56. Their identity was confirmed by projection using the Hao 2021 PBMC multi-modal atlas.
synonyms: CD56-bright cytokine secreting natural killer cell

labels.name: CD8 Effector Memory 2
labels.fullName: effector memory CD4-positive, alpha-beta T cell
labels.ontologyTerm: effector memory CD4-positive, alpha-beta T cell
labels.rationale: This population of CD8 T cell is defined by high levels of cytotoxicity. Their identity was confirmed by projection using the Hao 2021 PBMC multi-modal atlas.

labels.name: CD8 Tissue Resident Memory
labels.rationale: This CD8 T cell population represents Tissue Resident Memory T cells, their identity was confirmed by projection using the Hao 2021 PBMC multi-modal atlas.

labels.name: CD8 Effector Memory 1
labels.fullName: effector memory CD8-positive, alpha-beta T cell
labels.ontologyTerm: effector memory CD8-positive, alpha-beta T cell
labels.rationale: This population of CD8 T cell is defined by moderate levels of cytotoxicity. Their identity was confirmed by projection using the Hao 2021 PBMC multi-modal atlas.
labels.categoryFullName: CD8-positive, alpha-beta memory T cell, CD45RO-positive
labels.categoryOntologyTerm: CD8-positive, alpha-beta memory T cell, CD45RO-positive

labels.ontologyTerm: effector memory CD4-positive, alpha-beta T cell
labels.rationale: This CD4 T cell population represents Effector Memory T cells, their identity was confirmed by projection using the Hao 2021 PBMC multi-modal atlas.
labels.categoryFullName: CD4-positive, alpha-beta memory T cell, CD45RO-positive
labels.categoryOntologyTerm: CD4-positive, alpha-beta memory T cell, CD45RO-positive

labels.name: CD4 Regulatory
labels.fullName: CD4-positive, CD25-positive, alpha-beta regulatory T cell
labels.ontologyTerm: CD4-positive, CD25-positive, alpha-beta regulatory T cell
labels.rationale: This CD4 T cell population represents Regulatory T cells, their identity was confirmed by projection using the Hao 2021 PBMC multi-modal atlas.

labels.name: CD8 Naive
labels.fullName: naive thymus-derived CD8-positive, alpha-beta T cell
labels.ontologyTerm: naive thymus-derived CD8-positive, alpha-beta T cell
labels.rationale: This is a CD8 naive population that clusters together with CD4 naive T cells. Its identity was confirmed by projection using the Hao 2021 PBMC multi-modal atlas.

labels.name: Megakaryocyte
labels.rationale: This is population expresses known megakaryocyte markers PLEK and ITGA2B (CD41) while also expressing tubulin genes associated with late-stages of megakaryocyte differentiation and platelet biogenesis including TUBB1 (encoding β1-tubulin) and TUBA4A (encoding α4A-tubulin).

labels.name: cDC2
labels.rationale: Projection of multiple PBMC and BM datasets confirm the identity of this population as cDC2. This is further supported by expression of markers including CLEC10A.

labels.name: cDC1
labels.rationale: Projection of multiple PBMC and BM datasets confirm the identity of this population as cDC1. This is further supported by expression of markers including CLEC9A.

labels.name: CD14 Mono
labels.rationale: Projection of multiple PBMC and BM datasets confirm the identity of this population as CD14 Monocytes. This is further supported by CD14 expression.

labels.name: ASDC
labels.rationale: This population represents the AXL+ SIGLEC6+ Dendritic Cell (also known as transitional DC) and represents an intermediate state between pDC and cDCs with notable expression of the markers AXL and SIGLEC6 among others.

labels.name: CD16 Mono
labels.rationale: Projection of multiple PBMC and BM datasets confirm the identity of this population as CD16 Monocytes. This is further supported by FCGR3A (CD16) expression.

labels.name: Polychromatic Erythroblast
labels.rationale: This population was annotated based on enrichment of a gene expression signature derived from FACS-sorted polychromatic erythroblast cells. The identity was further confirmed based on ordering along erythroid development and based on persistence of cell cycle activity with hemoglobin transcripts constituting approximately 30-80% of the transcriptome.

labels.name: Orthochromatic Erythroblast
labels.rationale: This population was annotated based on enrichment of a gene expression signature derived from FACS-sorted orthochromatic erythroblast cells. The identity was further confirmed based on ordering along erythroid development and based on the absence of cell cycle activity with hemoglobin transcripts constituting approximately >80% of the transcriptome.

labels.name: Stromal
labels.rationale: This population represents non-hematopoietic stromal cells, and this is further supported by expression of stromal-specific genes including LEPR.

labels.name: Late ProMono
labels.rationale: Pro-monocytes are positioned downstream of GMP-Mono and upstream of CD14 Monocytes. Their labels were confirmed through projection of pro-monocyte single-cell transcriptomes previously labeled by van Galen and colleagues (2019). The Late Pro-Mono is positioned further in pseudotime and has acquired low levels of immunophenotypic CD14 which is absent from the Early Pro-Mono.
